SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File-No. 7871
S. 1. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date April 13, 1937.

Subject Li Zoong Sing, a Chinese Communist Suspect.

Made by D. S. Hamashita Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

The local Japanese Consular Police have received the
following information regarding Li Zoong Sing(李從心), a
Chinese communist suspect, from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police:-
Li Zoong Sing, alias Lih Kung Zai(列躬射), aged 25,
native of Zao Sin Hsien(饒平縣), Kwangtung Province,
graduated from a normal school maintained by the Kwangtung
Provincial Government in June, 1929, and in September, the
same year, he was admitted to the University of China?(中國公學
大學) located in Shanghai. After three years study in the
university Li proceeded to Japan in September, 1934, with the
object of receiving further education, and in March, 1936, he
entered the Social Science Section of the Nippon University,
Tokyo. Whilst residing in Shanghai he devoted himself to
reading communistic literature and became interested in
communism. After his arrival in Japan he also studied
communist doctrines. In February, 1936, with the object of
propagating communist principles, he contributed an article
with the heading "Ah Q"(阿Q) to the first issue of the
Eastern Literature(東方文藝), a communistic magazine, dated
March 25, 1936. This magazine was published by Li's friend
named Hou Feng(候楓) residing in Shanghai and the article
in question was a description of life in a prison, which story
he claimed to have heard from one named Ling Kong(林光), a
member of the Chinese Communist Party. Afterwards Li
contributed other articles of the same nature to the magazine.
Towards the end of March, 1936, he obtained one hundred copies
of the magazine from Hou Feng in Shanghai and distributed them
among Chinese students in Tokyo and also Japanese people through
a Japanese book store.

（印：C.P.D. 14 APR. 1937 CHANGPAI）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 7871
S. 1. 特别分部警署，
报告
日期 1937年4月13日。

事由 李從心，一名中国共产党嫌疑分子。

撰写人 D. S. Hamashita（音译） 转呈人 J. Boyne 副总督察

当地日本领事馆警察从东京警视厅收到以下关于中国共产党嫌疑分子李從心(李從心)的情报：
李從心，化名列躬射(列躬射)，25岁，广东省饶平县(饒平縣)人，1929年6月毕业于广东省立师范学校，同年9月进入位于上海的中國公學大學?(中國公學大學)。在该大学学习三年后，李于1934年9月前往日本深造，并于1936年3月进入东京日本大学社会科学科。在上海居住期间，他致力于阅读共产主义文献，并对共产主义产生兴趣。抵达日本后，他也研究共产主义学说。1936年2月，为了宣传共产主义原则，他在1936年3月25日出版的共产主义杂志《东方文艺》(東方文藝)创刊号上发表了一篇题为“阿Q”(阿Q)的文章。该杂志由李的朋友候楓(候楓)在上海出版，该文章描述了监狱生活，李称这个故事是从一名叫林光(林光)的中国共产党党员那里听来的。此后，李又向该杂志投稿了其他同类性质的文章。1936年3月底，他从上海的候楓(候楓)处获得一百本杂志，并将其分发给在东京的中国学生，还通过一家日本书店分发给日本人。

（印：C.P.D. 1937年4月14日 CHANGPAI（原文不清））

Li was arrested on March 9, 1937, and the Police
authorities instructed him to leave Japan, as they considered
that his activities were detrimental to peace and order.
He left Yokohama for Shanghai on board the s.s. "Rokko Maru"
on March 22.
